issues.quote: Félix carries his father's silver watch and has never let anyone touch it, my husband included.
issues.fact: The fact sheet says only that Félix's watch showed twenty minutes to nine and that Aurèle scolded him. It says nothing about the watch's ownership or whether anyone had handled it.
issues.misreading: A solver could read this as vouching that Félix's watch was never adjusted, so the 8:40 reading is trustworthy as a true time, or could wonder whether the watch shown was the father's watch. Neither is supported by the sheet.

issues.quote: He tells each owner what is wrong with his watch.
issues.fact: The sheet gives no information about the watches' errors or any known deviation from true time. It only states the readings.
issues.misreading: A solver could infer that Félix's watch has a known fault (running fast or slow) and correct the 8:40 reading accordingly, which the sheet does not license.
